#40's tests/test_phase2_gate.py::test_no_historical_corpus_or_verdict_changes_on_the_ledger_shape now builds its reference loader with attribute_trades instead of _STRATEGY_MAP (separate two-line commit). It again isolates the reconciliation-artifact exclusion; its assertions are unchanged.

The rule depends on the current engine values: alpha 0.01 without an ML signal; pure breakout 0.005 + 0.015 * composite with a 0.55 floor; ml_spoke false for both while isolated; the 'breakout' label only below 0.003. test_isolation_signatures_match_the_engine_source pins these expressions, and they are unchanged on 53bd8a11. A change that moves values outside both signatures only makes rows ambiguous (fails closed). Only a collision could misattribute (an alpha candidate recorded inside the band, or a pure breakout at exactly 0.01), and that needs an edit to engine code.

If ML influence returns (research-policy lock lifted), every 'alpha+breakout' row with ml_spoke true is ambiguous, so the momentum and breakout verdicts stay AMBIGUOUS_ATTRIBUTION until the root fix lands. This is by design.

The 'breakout' label keeps its meaning as instructed. Outside isolation, an alpha candidate with an ML predicted_return below 0.003 and breakout_score >= 0.55 would also carry it. That cannot happen while ML is isolated, because alpha records 0.01.

ml_spoke has been persisted since 2026-06-11, and brain_persistence rewrote older rows as False. The isolation test therefore cannot separate pre-June ML-era rows, but all of them predate every forward cutoff.
The daily pack keeps READY_FOR_REVIEW when a gate is AMBIGUOUS_ATTRIBUTION, because status is about evidence quality. The owner reads the state for each strategy.
scripts/phase2_freeze.py --verify (active, committed 2026-09-25 reference) exits 1 on this branch exactly as on 53bd8a11 (byte-identical output); candidate verify exits 0 on both.
follow_ups: Root fix (owner-signed frozen-surface change, resets the forward clock): set entry_source_override='breakout' and persist fw_strategy in the pure-breakout candidate inside _live_tick_inner (entry_gates_dispatch). Decide in the same change whether ORGANISM_BAD_REGIME_FILTER_SOURCES adds 'breakout'; otherwise pure breakouts stop being blocked in chop/trending_down. Then attribute by the persisted fw_strategy and keep the signature rule only for earlier rows.
Related open findings not addressed here: O2-10 (the CLIs use the env cost default of 3 bps, the pack uses 6 bps) and O2-11 (minimum-session guard and stale docstring).
Pre-existing, out of scope: scripts/phase3_attribution_report.py raises KeyError in section [2] when organism_brain/trade_history.csv is missing (pd.DataFrame() has no 'strategy' column).
verdict_outputs_changed: Rule ml_isolation_signature_v1 (phase2_gate.attribute_trades, used by load_forward_corpus after the reconciliation-artifact exclusion): an 'alpha+breakout' row with ml_spoke recorded false is momentum when predicted_return is 0.01 (within 1e-9) and breakout when it is in [0.01325, 0.0200]; any other 'alpha+breakout' row is 'ambiguous'. 'alpha', 'breakout', 'orb'/'orb_sip' and 'mr'/'mean_reversion' keep their mapping.

New gate state AMBIGUOUS_ATTRIBUTION: an ambiguous trade in the slice it could join (momentum: trend regimes only; breakout: all regimes) makes that state AMBIGUOUS_ATTRIBUTION, with look and t null and a note. It is never PASS or FAIL. orb and mean_reversion are unaffected; looks, boundaries and costs are unchanged.

Every gate result gains n_by_source ({alpha, pure_breakout, ambiguous}, plus orb or mean_reversion for those strategies) and attribution_rule='ml_isolation_signature_v1'. momentum n now counts only alpha trades in the trend slice; breakout n counts 'breakout' labels plus pure breakouts identified by the signature.
scripts/phase2_gate.py prints 'n per source: alpha=.. pure_breakout=.. ambiguous=.. orb=.. mean_reversion=..', a line naming the rule, and an 'n per source:' line for each strategy.

scripts/phase3_attribution_report.py prints the same corpus line in [1], where trades that cannot be split appear as strategy 'ambiguous'. In [2], each gate line ends with '[n per source: ...]', and an AMBIGUOUS_ATTRIBUTION line also prints its note.

Daily evidence pack: each strategy_gate entry carries n_by_source and attribution_rule; the momentum/breakout state can be AMBIGUOUS_ATTRIBUTION. Pack status (READY_FOR_REVIEW/BLOCKED, decided by evidence quality) and promotion_authorized=false are unchanged.
